newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares drop, driven down by Probanka.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares drop, driven down by Probanka.

text.p: Slovenian shares continued falling on Thursday, closing 1.31 percent lower on a more than seven percent loss in Probanka.
"There is no sign of fresh capital inflow to our market, and as I don't expect the political situation here to improve soon, the downward trend could continue for a while," one broker said.
* The SBI index fell 16.91 points to 1,271.86.
* Food maker Kolinska was the most active, easing 0.75 percent to 1,851 tolars on volume of 10,282 shares.
* Bank Probanka led the day's decliners, tumbling 7.62 percent to 19,400 tolars on volume of 490 shares. Traders said the bank fell due to its poor liquidity. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
